notes.title: Steam Deck the 'perfect platform' for their game say Escape From Castle Matsumoto devs
notes.notes:
Escape From Castle Matsumoto looks like quite a unique one, and the developers give the Steam Deck some rather high praise.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/10/steam-deck-the-perfect-platform-for-their-game-say-escape-from-castle-matsumoto-devs

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Escape From Castle Matsumoto will be 100% Steam Deck compatible, including an official input layout. In fact, Steam Deck will be THE perfect platform for our game.
